user.title: Protect Rules
user.description: Adds, for every UniFi Protect Alarm Manager rule, an on/off switch, a 24-hour hit count, a last-fired time and an event that fires when the rule does. It uses the connection of the UniFi Protect integration, so there is nothing to fill in.

abort.already_configured: Protect Rules is already set up
abort.single_instance_allowed: Protect Rules is already set up
abort.protect_not_loaded: Set up the UniFi Protect integration first
abort.zones_not_installed: Protect Zones isn't installed. Install it (it shares its connection to Protect with this integration), restart Home Assistant, then add Protect Rules again.

set_cooldown.name: Set rule cooldown
set_cooldown.description: Make Protect rules stay quiet for a while after they fire (good for noisy rules like Motion). Admin users only.

enabled.name: Cooldown on
enabled.description: Turn the cooldown on or off.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the rule stays quiet after firing.
